title: 第12章  你管这叫练气期？谁家练气期能秒我！
slug: 长生让你延续香火没让你量产仙帝
content_zh:
阳光刺破乌云。
洒落在安置区斑驳的土墙上。
安置区一切如常，仿佛昨天无事发生。
李长生很平静，抱着儿子平平，坐在院子的躺椅上，摇啊摇。
虽然平平刚出生，但比很多婴儿都强壮。
强壮不是指体重。
而是指力量。
李长生看向平平，身体周围灵气汇聚，环绕左右。
感叹一声：
真不愧是先天剑体啊！
这灵气亲和度。
着实令人嫉妒。
李长生都羡慕自己的种了。如果我有这天赋的话，早就成为青云宗的天骄了。
这时旁边宁宁，将头凑过来，用手指戳了戳弟弟的脸，奶声奶气：
“弟弟好丑。”
“皱巴巴的。”
李长生笑了笑：
“刚出生都这样。”
“过几天长开了就好看了。”
宁宁笑了笑：“切！就是没有我好看。”

李长生刮了刮宁宁的鼻子。
你弟弟才刚出生。
怎么就欺负起弟弟来了？
真是腹黑的姐姐。
因为江翠萍刚生产完毕，身体还很虚弱，正在里屋休息。
照顾孩子的任务自然落在李长生身上。
李长生跟两个孩子在庭院里面玩。
倒也很平静。
仿佛昨晚的杀戮从未发生过。
其实他知道现在的宁静只不过在凝聚更大的风暴罢了。
他昨晚宰了两位魔修。
肯定是谢剑的【白手套】。
或者是某个大人物的【白手套】。
按照正常逻辑。
现在谢剑肯定察觉到白手套消失了。
但没有第一时间来安置区调查。
这是为什么呢？
原因很简单。
谢剑不敢信。
安置区是什么地方？

是青云宗淘汰下来的【废品站】。
住在这里的，都是一群练气三四层、行将就木的老废物。
虽然有凡人，也有在这里修炼了几代人的修士，但都是很菜的。
怎么可能是两位炼气高阶魔修的对手？
明明是稳当的事情。
偏偏出现意外。
而且连尸体都没有找到。
这不科学啊？
谢剑怀疑是不是有其他势力插手了？
或者是安置区有隐藏的高手？
李长生要的就是这个效果。
疑兵之计。
让对方摸不清虚实。
不敢轻举妄动。
这样他就有更多的时间去巩固修为，熟悉新的力量。
其实李长生猜测得没错。
一晚死去两个炼气高阶的魔修。
谢剑的确被镇住了。
一连三天。
安置区都出奇地安静。

期间没有新失踪案发生。
也没有执法弟子来敲门。
安置区的老头们，也敢从家里出来，吹牛打牌了。
一切都很和谐。
仿佛危险已经离开。
唯独李长生没有放松警惕。
谢剑是腐朽仙门的主要人物之一，甚至跟魔门都有勾结，现在不出手，是因为尚未查清楚情况，或者说在等。
李长生筑基之后。
倒没有那么害怕了。
至少自己不再是那个任人宰割的蝼蚁了。
而且他隐藏在暗处，以有心算无心，优势还是在他这边的。
第四天夜里。
李长生盘膝坐在院子中央，神识如水银泻地，覆盖了方圆三里。
筑基期的神识。
比练气期强了太多。
方圆三公里内，任何风吹草动，都逃不过其感知。
突然李长生眉头一皱。
在其灵识中，忽然感觉到一股极其阴冷，带着浓烈桃花煞气的气息，突兀闯入了安置区。
这股气息很强。
练气大圆满。

半步筑基。
“安置区被阵法封锁了。”
“哪里来的半步筑基？”
“所以应该是……”
“应该是谢剑故意从外面放进来的……”
李长生想通了这一层，并没有过于害怕。
半步筑基而已。
在以前，或许无法战胜对方。
但是现在只不过是稍微强壮一点的蚂蚁罢了。
如果对方威胁到自己，那就将对方宰了便是了。
与此同时。
安置区入口。
一个身穿粉色锦袍，手持白骨折扇的年轻男子，大摇大摆地走了进来。
其面容妖异，肤色惨白，嘴唇红艳得像是刚喝过血。
这便是合欢宗内门弟子沈醉。
“谢剑那个老废物，真是越活越回去了。”
“区区一个安置区，几个老掉牙的废物，就把他吓住了？”
“还要请本公子出手？”
“至于吗？”
“不过。”

“看着那一位的面子上，我就勉为其难了。”
沈醉摇着扇子，脸色冷峻。
他来安置区。
有两个目的。
一是帮谢剑探探路，解决掉那个【隐藏高手】。
二是……
他听说安置区里的凡人家族生了不少婴儿。
刚出生的婴儿先天之气最足。
尤其是那些有灵根的婴儿。
若是能用来炼制【子母阴煞雷】。
可是大补啊！
作为合欢宗的弟子，竟然被请来干活了，那就没有空手而归的道理。
沈醉想着，舔了舔嘴唇，眼中闪过嗜血光芒。
他静静在街道上走着。
既没有刻意隐藏修为。
也没有刻意展示修为。
但安置区失踪的人口多了，自然形成了一个天黑别出门的规矩，没有什么人不怕死，敢冲上来问话。
沈醉一路走，一路用神识扫视着两旁的房屋。
“太弱了。”
“全是垃圾。”

“这种货色，连给本公子提鞋都不配。”
“不是说有很多女修生了孩子吗？”
“怎么一个都没看见？”
沈醉摇了摇头，一脸失望。
就在这时。
其目光突然定格在一个偏僻的小院上。
“咦？”
“有点意思。”
“刚才我路过几次了，都没有留意到小院的存在。”
“现在仔细一看，小院竟然布置了屏蔽阵法。”
沈醉眼睛一亮。
瞬间来了兴致。
安置区正常的家庭，何须遮遮掩掩的？也没有遮遮掩掩的实力。
这屏蔽阵法可是不简单啊！
沈醉心念一动，化作一道粉色流光，直扑李家小院。
与此同时。
李长生坐在庭院内，用灵识静静地观察着沈醉，总感觉有些熟悉，一会之后，终于认出来了。
这人他认识。
或者说见过。
当初在鬼市中，牛四将自己举报给合欢宗，就是这位年轻男子来追踪自己的。如果没记错的话，当初牛四称呼这位叫沈公子。

所以说……
合欢宗的人来追杀我？
还是说谢剑背叛了仙门，跟合欢宗合作？
李长生不知道。
但是他发现沈醉正在向自己的院子走过来。
我还没找你。
你就找上门来了？
李长生非常无奈。
他是一位苟修。
并不想徒增杀戮。
但是……
麻烦找上门。
也不会手软。
李长生喃喃一声，杀气自起。
躲是躲不过的。
唯有杀戮。
才是了却因果的最佳办法。
杀你并非我所愿。
我只是了却因果罢了。
李长生想到这里，旋即站起身，手持玄霜剑，一步跨出院门，向沈醉迎上去。沈醉是半步筑基，屏蔽阵法已经屏蔽不了战斗波动了，倒不如在沈醉进入院子之前，将其击杀。

沈醉正迈步前进，忽然脚步一顿，急刹车。
只因其眼前突然出现了一个穿破旧道袍白发苍苍的老头。
该老头。
驼着背。
背着手。
冷冷地扫视前方。
目光恍若在看一个死人。
沈醉被盯得有些发毛。
“你是谁？”
“你不是找我吗？”
李长生发出一阵嘶哑的声音。
旋即右手反握，玄霜剑一剑劈出。
剑气夹带着冰霜向沈醉的面门劈下。
先下手为强。
后下手遭殃。
李长生作为苟修，出手便不留情，全力以赴。
“你……”
“你身上怎么会有合欢宗的血煞之气？”
“你杀了合欢宗的人？”
沈醉只来得及说这一句，便看到李长生开始攻击了。

刚开始满脸不屑。
因为安置区都是老弱病残，蝼蚁一个。
有什么值得自己注意的？
沈醉手中折扇一挥。
数十道阴魂呼啸而出，化作一只巨大的鬼爪，带着凄厉的惨叫声，向李长生抓去。
这一招。
名为【百鬼夜行】。
是沈醉在上古遗迹中得到的法术。寻常练气期修士，只要沾上一星半点，就会被阴魂入体，神魂俱灭。
威力颇为不俗。
下一秒。
他的笑容僵在了脸上。
那个看起来弱不禁风的老头，轻轻劈出的剑气，却轻轻松松将鬼爪劈成两半。
“什么？”
沈醉大惊失色，眼珠子差点瞪出来。
他可是半步筑基修为啊！
就算是同阶修士，也不敢如此托大，硬接这一招。
这老头隐藏了修为？
没等他反应过来。
李长生再次动了。
一步跨出。

缩地成寸。
瞬间出现在沈醉面前。
那张苍老的脸庞上，没有任何表情。
“死吧。”
李长生声音不大，却如同重锤，狠狠砸在沈醉心口。
沈醉汗毛倒竖，死亡笼罩全身。现在他终于看出了，眼前这老头哪里是什么老弱病残？分明就是筑基期的大修。
“你……你是筑基……”
沈醉想逃跑。
但已经晚了。
李长生伸出一只手，看似缓慢，实则快若闪电，一把掐住了沈醉的脖子，像拎住了一个小鸡。
“咔嚓。”
李长生手轻轻一拧，便将沈醉的护体灵罩捏碎了。
“呃……呃……”
沈醉双脚离地，拼命挣扎。
但他发现体内的灵力，竟然完全被压制住了，一丝一毫都调动不起来。
筑基期对半步筑基。
就是降维打击。
沈醉的眼中充满了恐惧和绝望。
他怎么也想不明白。
这个破烂不堪的安置区里，为什么会藏着一位筑基大修？

而且还是一个扮猪吃虎心狠手辣的老阴比。
李长生没有废话，手上猛地用力。
“噗嗤。”
沈醉骨头碎裂，脖子被捏断，脑袋无力耷拉了下来。
content_en:
The sun breaks through the dark clouds.
Sprinkled on the mottled earth walls of the settlement area.
Everything in the resettlement area is as usual, as if nothing happened yesterday.
Li Changsheng was very calm, holding his son Pingping in his arms, sitting on the deck chair in the yard, rocking and rocking.
Although he was just born, he was stronger than many babies.
Being strong is not about weight.
But it refers to strength.
Li Changsheng looked at Pingping, and spiritual energy gathered around his body, surrounding him.
Sigh:
It truly is an innate sword body!
This aura affinity.
It's really jealous.
Li Changsheng was envious of his own seed. If I had this talent, I would have become the genius of Qingyun Sect long ago.
At this time, Ning Ning, who was next to her, leaned her head over, poked her brother's face with her finger, and said in a sweet voice:
"My brother is so ugly."
"Wrinkled."
Li Changsheng smiled:
"It's been like this since birth."
"It will look better when it grows out in a few days."
Ning Ning smiled: "Tsk! It's just not as good-looking as me."
Li Changsheng scratched Ning Ning's nose.
Your brother was just born.
Why did you bully your younger brother?
What a sinister sister.
Because Jiang Cuiping had just given birth and was still very weak and was resting in the back room.
The task of taking care of the children naturally falls on Li Changsheng.
Li Changsheng was playing with two children in the courtyard.
It was quite peaceful.
It was as if last night's killing had never happened.
In fact, he knew that the current tranquility was just gathering a bigger storm.
He killed two demon cultivators last night.
It must be Xie Jian's [White Gloves].
Or a [white glove] of some big shot.
Follow normal logic.
Now Xie Jian must have noticed that the white gloves disappeared.
But there was no immediate investigation into the resettlement area.
Why is this?
The reason is simple.
Xie Jian couldn't believe it.
Where is the resettlement area?
It is the [Scrap Depot] that was eliminated by the Qingyun Sect.
The people living here are all a group of old losers who are on the third or fourth level of Qi training and are on their deathbed.
Although there are mortals and monks who have been practicing here for generations, they are all very good.
How could he be the opponent of two high-level Qi-refining demon cultivators?
It's obviously a safe thing.
An accident happened.
And not even a body was found.
Isn't this scientific?
Xie Jian wondered if other forces were involved?
Or is there a hidden master in the resettlement area?
This is what Li Changsheng wants.
Suspicious tactics.
Let the other party not understand the truth.
Don't dare to act rashly.
This way he would have more time to consolidate his cultivation and become familiar with the new power.
In fact, Li Changsheng's guess was correct.
Two high-level Qi-refining demon cultivators died in one night.
Xie Jian was indeed restrained.
Three days in a row.
The resettlement areas were all eerily quiet.
No new disappearances occurred during this period.
No law enforcement disciples came knocking on the door.
The old men in the resettlement area also dared to come out of their homes to brag and play cards.
Everything is in harmony.
It was as if the danger had left.
Only Li Changsheng did not let down his guard.
Xie Jian is one of the main figures of the Decaying Immortal Sect, and even colludes with the Demon Sect. He is not taking action now because he has not yet found out the situation, or he is waiting.
After Li Changsheng established the foundation.
Not so scared anymore.
At least I am no longer the ant who is at the mercy of others.
Moreover, he hides in the dark and calculates with his mind but not his heart. The advantage is still on his side.
On the fourth night.
Li Changsheng sat cross-legged in the center of the courtyard, his consciousness pouring down like mercury on the ground, covering a three-mile radius.
Divine consciousness in the foundation building stage.
Much stronger than during the Qi training period.
Within a radius of three kilometers, any disturbance cannot escape its perception.
Suddenly Li Changsheng frowned.
In his spiritual consciousness, he suddenly felt an extremely cold and strong aura of peach blossoms, which suddenly broke into the resettlement area.
This aura is very strong.
Qi practice Dzogchen.
Half step to build the foundation.
"The settlement area is blocked by the formation."
"Where did the half-step foundation construction come from?"
"So it should be...""Xie Jian should have let it in from outside on purpose..."
Li Changsheng figured this out and was not too afraid.
It’s just a half-step to build the foundation.
In the past, it might have been impossible to defeat the opponent.
But now it's just a slightly stronger ant.
If the other party threatens you, just kill the other party.
at the same time.
Entrance to the resettlement area.
A young man wearing a pink brocade robe and holding a white fractured fan walked in swaggeringly.
His face was strange, his complexion was pale, and his lips were as red as if he had just drank blood.
This is Shen Zui, an inner disciple of Hehuan Sect.
"Xie Jian, that old good-for-nothing, is really getting better and better."
"A few old losers in a resettlement area scared him?"
"You still want me to take action?"
"As for it?"
"But."
"Looking at that person's face, I reluctantly did it."
Shen Zui shook his fan with a stern look on his face.
He came to the resettlement area.
There are two purposes.
The first is to help Xie Jian explore the path and get rid of the [hidden master].
The second is...
He heard that the mortal families in the resettlement area had given birth to many babies.
Newly born babies have the most innate energy.
Especially those babies with spiritual roots.
If it can be used to refine [Zi Mu Yin Sha Lei].
But it’s a great supplement!
As a disciple of the Hehuan Sect, he was actually invited to work, so there was no reason to return empty-handed.
Shen Zui thought, licking his lips, a bloodthirsty light flashing in his eyes.
He walked quietly down the street.
Neither did he deliberately hide his cultivation.
He didn't deliberately show off his cultivation.
However, as there were so many people missing in the resettlement area, a rule was naturally formed not to go out after dark. No one who was not afraid of death would dare to rush up and ask questions.
Shen Zui walked along, scanning the houses on both sides with his spiritual consciousness.
"Too weak."
"It's all rubbish."
"This kind of thing is not even worthy of carrying my son's shoes."
"Didn't you say that many female nuns gave birth to children?"
"Why didn't you see anyone?"
Shenzui shook his head, looking disappointed.
Just then.
His gaze suddenly focused on a remote courtyard.
"Huh?"
"It's interesting."
"I passed by it a few times just now, but I didn't notice the existence of the courtyard."
"Now if I look carefully, I can see that a shielding formation has been set up in the small courtyard."
Shenzui's eyes lit up.
I suddenly became interested.
Why do normal families in the resettlement area need to be secretive? There is no secretive strength.
This shielding formation is not simple!
With a thought in Shenzui's mind, it turned into a pink stream of light and went straight to the Li family courtyard.
at the same time.
Li Changsheng sat in the courtyard and quietly observed Shen Zui with his spiritual sense. He always felt a little familiar. After a while, he finally recognized it.
He knew this man.
Or have seen it.
Back in the ghost market, Niu Si reported himself to the Hehuan Sect, and it was this young man who tracked him. If I remember correctly, Niu Si called this Mr. Shen back then.
So...
People from the Hehuan Sect are coming to hunt me down?
Or is it that Xie Jian betrayed the Xianmen and cooperated with the Hehuan Sect?
Li Changsheng didn't know.
But he found Shen Zui walking towards his yard.
I haven't found you yet.
You just came to the door?
Li Changsheng was very helpless.
He is a cultivator.
I don't want to increase the number of killings.
But...
Please come to your door.
He won't be lenient either.
Li Changsheng murmured, murderous intent arose.
There is no way to hide.
Only killing.
This is the best way to resolve the cause and effect.
Killing you is not what I want.
I just know the cause and effect.
Li Changsheng thought of this, and immediately stood up, holding the Xuan Shuang Sword in his hand, and stepped out of the courtyard to greet Shen Zui. Shen Zui is building a foundation in half a step, and the shielding formation can no longer shield the battle fluctuations. It is better to kill Shen Zui before he enters the courtyard.
Shen Zui was walking forward when suddenly he stopped and stopped suddenly.
Just because of his eyesSuddenly an old man with white hair wearing a worn Taoist robe appeared in front of him.
That old man.
Hunched.
Hands behind back.
He glanced ahead coldly.
His eyes seemed to be looking at a dead person.
Shen Zui was stared at and felt a little hairy.
"Who are you?"
"Aren't you looking for me?"
Li Changsheng made a hoarse voice.
Immediately, he held his right hand behind his back and struck out with the Xuan Shuang Sword.
The sword energy, mixed with ice, struck down at Shenzui's face.
Strike first to gain the upper hand.
Then he started to suffer disaster.
As a cultivator, Li Changsheng was merciless and went all out.
"You..."
"Why do you have the blood evil aura of the Hehuan Sect in you?"
"Did you kill people from the Hehuan Sect?"
Shen Zui only had time to say this before he saw Li Changsheng start to attack.
At first I was full of disdain.
Because the resettlement area is full of old, weak, sick and disabled people, just like ants.
Is there anything worth paying attention to?
Shen Zui waved the folding fan in his hand.
Dozens of ghosts roared out, turned into a huge ghost claw, and grabbed Li Changsheng with a shrill scream.
This move.
It's called [Hundred Ghosts at Night].
It is a spell obtained by indulging in ancient ruins. Ordinary monks in the qi training period, as long as they get a little bit of it, the ghost will enter their body and their soul will be destroyed.
The power is quite impressive.
The next second.
His smile froze on his face.
The old man who looked so frail could easily split the ghost claw in half with his sword energy.
"What?"
Shen Zui was so shocked that his eyes nearly popped out.
He is half a step into foundation building!
Even monks of the same level would not dare to be so confident and take this move forcefully.
Is this old man hiding his cultivation?
Before he could react.
Li Changsheng moved again.
Take one step forward.
Shrunk into inches.
Appeared in front of Shen Zui instantly.
There was no expression on that old face.
"Die."
Li Changsheng's voice was not loud, but it was like a heavy hammer hitting Shen Zui's heart.
Intoxicated, the hair on the hair stood on end, and death enveloped the whole body. Now he finally saw that the old man in front of him was old, weak, sick and disabled. It is clearly a major overhaul in the foundation building period.
"You...you are Zhuji..."
Shen Zui wanted to escape.
But it's too late.
Li Changsheng stretched out a hand, which seemed slow, but was actually as fast as lightning, and grabbed Shen Zui's neck, like a chicken.
"Click."
Li Changsheng crushed Shenzui's body-protecting spirit shield with a slight twist of his hand.
"Uh... uh..."
Shenzui lifted his feet off the ground and struggled desperately.
But he found that the spiritual power in his body was completely suppressed and could not be mobilized at all.
During the foundation building period, build the foundation in half steps.
It's a dimensionality reduction attack.
